design: Months and integers,8query inputs each,4disjoint demonstrations, next/previous/copy arrow prompts. Native competence threshold6/8 per operation fixed before inference. All paired donor operations tested, receiver value fixed. All outcomes retained regardless of competence.
limitations: One format/demo order, small reused month vocabulary. Changing operations changes demonstrations as well as instruction. Coefficient transplants are local activation edits, not complete circuit interchange.
